messages:
elaine_pm: Heads-up: BlueLattice SI wants co-sell + marketplace presence. Need intake flow + clear rules for lead ownership and announcement approvals.

omar_bd: They sell appliance + managed services. Marketplace should show appliance only; services routed to partner.

rachel_ops: We must exclude finance and health verticals for direct contracting. Automation should tag those and route direct to BlueLattice.

elaine_pm: Proposed routing: marketplace_checkout -> PartnerOps queue; partner_form -> BlueLattice AE; existing_redwood_account -> Redwood AE keeps primary. Add partner_tag + handshake_date in SFDC.

leo_legal: Note: co-branded release needs 10-day review and logo license. Clarify who signs SOWs vs MSA. BlueLattice prefers delivery SOWs.

omar_bd: Draft mapping CSV:
account_type,lead_source,primary,secondary_credit
existing_redwood,manual,redwood_ae,bluelattice_delivery
partner_sourced,partner_form,bluelattice_ae,redwood_share
marketplace,checkout,partnerops_queue,none
regulated,manual,bluelattice_direct,redwood_notify

rachel_ops: I'll add SFDC automation and tag blue_lattice_direct_exempt. Also create #partners-routing alerts.

partners-bot: :reminder: co-marketing assets due in 9 days. Create PR under /marketing/partners/bluelattice.

elaine_pm: Next steps:
- @rachel_ops: implement SFDC flow (ETA 72h)
- @leo_legal: draft announcement agreement (ETA 5d)
- @omar_bd: schedule 3 pilot demos (ETA 2w)

elaine_pm: locking this as initial play unless objections. :white_check_mark:
